blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Temporal reasoning is widely assumed to decompose into two modes: temporal arithmetic (date and time calculations), and temporal semantics (understanding temporal and causal relations). This dichotomy shapes how benchmarks are designed, how models are trained, and how progress is measured, yet its empirical validity has never been directly tested. We provide two lines of evidence that challenge it. First, we test whether tasks labelled as arithmetic or semantic by the benchmarks support transferable gains within their purported mode. Finetuning on these subsets yields predominantly dataset-specific gains ($+6.8$ to $+23.1$ percentage points), while transfer to a different dataset in the same mode ranges from $-3.2$ to $+1.1$ percentage points. Across the two benchmark families used in the transfer analysis, this pattern provides little evidence of coherent, transferable temporal abilities. Second, using cognitive-demand-based model evaluation, we examine which capabilities actually drive performance on these benchmarks. We find that quantitative and logical reasoning, the assumed proxies for temporal arithmetic and temporal semantics, are not the primary drivers; knowledge is. Together, these findings show that current temporal reasoning benchmarks do not cleanly realise the arithmetic-semantics distinction and instead largely reward models for remembering how time typically works.
blocks.zh: 时间推理被广泛认为分解为两种模式:时间算术(日期和时间计算)和时间语义(理解时间和因果关系). 这种二分法形状如何设计基准,如何训练模型,如何衡量进度,然而其经验有效性从未被直接测试. 我们提供了两条证据来挑战它。 首先,我们检验这些基准标注为算术或语义的任务是否支持在其预期模式范围内的可转让收益。 这些子集的微调主要产生数据集特定收益(+6.8美元至+23.1美元百分点),而向同一模式下不同的数据集的转移则从3.2美元到1.1美元百分点不等。 在转移分析中使用的两个基准家庭中,这种模式几乎没有提供连贯、可转移的时间能力的证据。 其次,我们利用基于认知需求的模式评价,审查哪些能力能真正推动这些基准的绩效。 我们认为,定量和逻辑推理,即时间算术和时间语义的假定代词,不是主要驱动力;知识是主要的。 这些调查结果共同表明,目前的时间推理基准并没有完全实现算术和语义的区分,而是在很大程度上奖励那些记起时间通常如何工作的模型。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Which cognitive abilities are required to reason about time? Prior work on large language models (LLMs)commonly decomposes temporal reasoning into two modes: temporal arithmetic , involving calculations over times and dates, and temporal semantics , involving the interpretation of before–after relations and temporal causality ( Wang and Zhao, 2024 ; Chu et al., 2024 ; Fatemi et al., 2025 ; Islakoglu and Kalo, 2025 ) . Both require an understanding of time, whereas temporal arithmetic additionally requires mathematical capabilities. This distinction has become a common organising principle for benchmark design, model training, and performance reporting ( Wang and Zhao, 2024 ; Chu et al., 2024 ; Su et al., 2024 ; Fatemi et al., 2025 ) . However, it remains unclear whether it reflects meaningful differences in the cognitive demands tested by current benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 需要哪些认知能力来解释时间? 以往关于大语言模型(LLMs)的工作通常将时间推理分解为两种模式:时间算法,涉及时间和日期的计算;时间语义,涉及关系和时间因果关系之前的解释(Wang and Zhao, 2024;Chu等人, 2024;Fatemi等人, 2025; Islakoglu and Kalo, 2025)。 两者都需要了解时间,而时间算术还需要数学能力。 这种区分已成为基准设计、示范培训和业绩报告的共同组织原则(Wang and Zhao, 2024;Chu等人, 2024;Su等人, 2024;Fatemi等人, 2025)。 然而,仍然不清楚它是否反映了目前基准所测试的认知需求方面的有意义的差异。

blocks.en:
This question matters because benchmarks may not measure what they claim to measure due to poor construct validity ( Bean et al., 2025 ) . As benchmarks become more complex, the true bottleneck may diverge from the target ability named in the task description ( Rameshkumar et al., 2025 ; Varela et al., 2026 ) .
For example, success on a temporal arithmetic question may depend more on numerical calculation than on temporal understanding, whereas success on a temporal semantics question may depend more on language comprehension or memorised world knowledge. The arithmetic/semantics distinction may therefore classify tasks by their surface form and not by the abilities that actually drive performance.
blocks.zh:
这个问题很重要,因为基准可能无法衡量由于构造有效性差而声称衡量的内容(Bean等人,2025年)。 随着基准变得更加复杂,真正的瓶颈可能不同于任务说明中指明的目标能力(Rameshkumar等人,2025年;Varela等人,2026年)。
例如,时间算术问题的成功可能更多地取决于数字计算而不是时间理解,而时间语义问题的成功可能更多地取决于语言理解或记忆世界知识。 因此,算术/语义的区分可能按任务表面形式而不是实际驱动性能的能力来分类.

blocks.en: We test this assumption in two ways. First, we ask whether the arithmetic/semantics distinction predicts transfer across benchmarks. We train LLMson temporal reasoning datasets and evaluate whether performance improvements generalise to unseen datasets, both within and across the two modes. If each mode reflects a stable capability with shared reasoning patterns, transfer should be strong between datasets in the same mode ( Shao et al., 2024 ; Hu et al., 2026 ; Ionov et al., 2026 ) . Instead, we find that improvements remain highly localised to the training data and barely generalise to unseen data in the same purported mode.
blocks.zh: 我们以两种方式检验这一假设。 首先,我们问,算术/语义的区分是否预测跨越基准的转移。 我们训练LLMson时间推理数据集,并评价性能改进是否在两种模式之内和之间将通用到看不见的数据集。 如果每种模式都反映具有共同推理模式的稳定能力,那么在相同模式的数据集之间,转移应该是强有力的(Shao等人,2024年;Hu等人,2026年;Ionov等人,2026年)。 相反,我们发现,在培训数据方面,改进仍然高度本地化,几乎无法以同样所谓的模式概括为看不见的数据。

blocks.en: Second, we test whether the arithmetic/semantics split reflects differences in cognitive demands. Using the Demand-Level-Annotation (DeLeAn)rubrics ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) , we score each benchmark item on 18 general cognitive dimensions. We compare arithmetic and semantic datasets across all DeLeAndimensions, but find no clear separation between the two modes. We then focus on the Quantitative Reasoning (QLq)and Logical Reasoning (QLl)cognitive demands, which are most naturally aligned with temporal arithmetic ( Su et al., 2024 ; Fatemi et al., 2025 ) and temporal semantics ( Xiong et al., 2024 ; Tang et al., 2025 ) , respectively. We train models on data with relatively high demands for each of the two dimensions and test whether this produces larger gains in the corresponding mode. It does not. Instead, we find that tasks depend more strongly on the cognitive demands for knowledge.
blocks.zh: 第二,我们测试算术/语义分裂是否反映了认知需求的差异. 使用需求级注释(DeLeAn)rubrics(周等人,2026年),我们在18个一般认知维度上对每个基准项目进行评分. 我们比较了所有DeLeAndimensions的算术和语义数据集,但没有发现两种模式之间的明确区分. 然后,我们着重讨论定量理性(QLq)和逻辑理性(QLl)认知要求,这些要求最自然地与时间算术(Su等人,2024年;Fatemi等人,2025年)和时间语义(Xiong等人,2024年;Tang等人,2025年)相一致。 我们用两个维度中每个维度要求相对较高的数据来训练模型,并测试这是否在相应的模式中产生更大的收益. 它没有。 相反,我们发现任务更依赖于对知识的认知需求。

blocks.en: Taken together, these results suggest that temporal reasoning benchmarks are better characterised as knowledge-heavy tasks than as tests of distinct arithmetic or semantic capabilities, with performance depending more on learned regularities and background knowledge than on explicit reasoning over temporal quantities or relations.
blocks.zh: 总之,这些结果表明,时间推理基准比对不同的算术或语义能力的测试更能定性为知识繁重的任务,其性能更多地取决于所学的规律和背景知识,而不是对时间数量或关系的明确推理。

blocks.en: 2 Background
blocks.zh: 2 背景情况

blocks.en: Temporal reasoning benchmarks commonly distinguish tasks requiring semantic temporal understanding from those that also require mathematical operations. For example, Su et al. (2024) note that 19 of the 38 tasks in TRAM ( Wang and Zhao, 2024 ) involve mathematical reasoning. TimeBench ( Chu et al., 2024 ) , which covers 10 temporal reasoning benchmarks, distinguishes symbolic tasks such as date arithmetic from those requiring only semantic temporal understanding, while Test of Time (ToT) ( Fatemi et al., 2025 ) explicitly has an Arithmetic and a Semantic subset. Across these efforts, the arithmetic/semantic split is treated as a meaningful axis of variation, yet none tests whether it reflects separable underlying abilities.
blocks.zh: 时间推理基准通常区分需要语义时间理解的任务和也需要数学操作的任务. 例如,苏等人(2024年)指出,TRAM的38项任务中有19项(王和赵,2024年)涉及数学推理. Time Bench(Chu et al., 2024),涵盖10个时间推理基准,将日期算术等象征性任务与仅需要语义时间理解的任务区分开来,而Test of Time(ToT)(Fatemi et al., 2025)则明确拥有一个算术和语义子集. 在整个这些努力中,算术/语义分裂被视作一个有意义的变异轴,但没有测试它是否反映了可分离的基本能力.

blocks.en: However, growing evidence questions the construct validity of LLM benchmarks—the extent to which they measure the abilities they claim to measure. Reviewing 445 benchmarks from major NLP and ML venues, Bean et al. (2025) find that many studies do not establish a clear link between the ability named by a benchmark and the abilities required to perform well on it. Alaa et al. (2025) identify a similar gap in medicine, where high scores on exam-style benchmarks do not reliably predict performance on real clinical data. More broadly, Rameshkumar et al. (2025) and Varela et al. (2026) show that the main performance bottleneck can diverge from the capability named in the task description as tasks become more complex. These findings suggest that benchmark categories require empirical validation. We apply this principle to temporal reasoning by testing whether the arithmetic/semantic labels of existing benchmarks predict transfer behaviour and cognitive abilities.
blocks.zh: 然而,越来越多的证据质疑LLM基准的构造有效性,即它们衡量它们声称衡量能力的程度。 Bean等人(2025年)审查了来自NLP和ML主要地点的445个基准,发现许多研究没有在基准所命名的能力与良好业绩所需的能力之间建立明确的联系。 Alaa等人著. (2025年)找出了类似的医学差距,在考试类基准上的高分无法可靠地预测真实临床数据的性能. 更广泛地说,拉梅什库马尔等人(2025年)和瓦雷拉等人(2026年)表明,随着任务变得更加复杂,主要性能瓶颈可能与任务描述中命名的能力有所区别. 这些调查结果表明,基准类别需要经验验证。 我们把这一原则应用于时间推理,通过测试现有基准的算术/语义标签是否预测了转移行为和认知能力.

blocks.en:
If temporal arithmetic and temporal semantics reflect genuinely distinct and coherent abilities, then improvements in one should transfer , at minimum, to other tasks within the same mode. This logic follows a standard rationale in the reasoning literature: training in a narrow
domain should generalise to tasks that draw on the same underlying capability. Shao et al. (2024) and Guo et al. (2025) show that reinforcement learning on mathematical benchmarks reliably transfers to other mathematical tasks and even to non-mathematical reasoning benchmarks, confirming that fine-tuning can yield cross-benchmark transfer when the underlying capability is shared. Whether the same holds for temporal reasoning
remains untested. Xiong et al. (2024) show that fine-tuning on temporal data can improve temporal reasoning, but do not test cross-mode transfer, and recent work suggests that transfer is not guaranteed across all domains ( Hu et al., 2026 ; Huan et al., 2026 ) . We use fine-tuning
transfer as a direct probe of the arithmetic/semantic distinction: if gains transfer within mode, the distinction has empirical grounding; if they do not, it lacks support as a description of separable abilities.
blocks.zh:
如果时间算术和时间语义反映了真正不同和一致的能力,那么,一个方法的改进至少应该转移到同一模式下的其他任务。 这种逻辑遵循推理文献中的标准原理: 狭义的训练
域应该泛指利用同样基础能力的任务。 Shao等人(2024年)和Guo等人(2025年)表明,关于数学基准的强化学习可靠地转移到其他数学任务,甚至转移到非数学推理基准,确认微调可以在共享基础能力时产生跨基准转移. 时间推理是否相同
尚未测试。 Xiong等人(2024年)表明,对时间数据进行微调可以改善时间推理,但不测试跨模式转移,近期的工作表明,转移并非在所有领域都有保障(Hu等人,2026年;Huan等人,2026年). 我们用微调
转让作为算术/语义区分的直接探针:如果在模式内收益转让,这种区分具有经验基础;如果没有,则缺乏支持作为可分离能力的描述。

blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en: 3.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集

blocks.en: We use nine temporal reasoning datasets from eight benchmarks, counting ToT Arithmetic and Semantic separately (Table 1 ). For the demand-profile analyses and item-level experiments, TCP is further divided into Long and Short subsets, yielding ten subsets. These datasets span a broad range of temporal phenomena, task formats, and dataset construction methods. This variation allows us to test whether the arithmetic/semantic distinction generalises beyond a particular benchmark or task format. We report training, validation, and test splits for each dataset partition. The size of each split is reported in the Appendix (Tables 4 and 5 ).
blocks.zh: 我们使用来自8个基准的9个时间推理数据集,分别计算ToT Arithmetic和Semantic(表1). 对于需求剖面分析和项目级实验,TCP进一步分为长子集和短子集,产生十个子集. 这些数据集涵盖广泛的时间现象、任务格式和数据集构建方法。 这一变化使我们能够测试算术/语义区分是否超出特定基准或任务格式。 我们报告每个数据集分区的培训、验证和测试分割。 附录(表4和表5)报告了每笔拆分的大小。

blocks.en: For the purposes of this study, QLqand QLlare the most relevant dimensions, as they map most directly onto the conventional arithmetic/semantic distinction. QLqcaptures the numerical demands associated with temporal arithmetic ( Su et al., 2024 ; Fatemi et al., 2025 ) , while QLlcaptures the relational and causal reasoning demands associated with temporal semantics ( Wang and Zhao, 2024 ; Xiong et al., 2024 ) . By comparing demand levels on these two dimensions at the item level, we can test whether the arithmetic/semantic distinction corresponds to a genuine difference in cognitive requirements, independently of the labels assigned by benchmark designers.
blocks.zh: 为本研究的目的,QLqand QLlare最相关的维度,因为它们最直接地映射到传统的算术/语义区分上. QLqcaptures 与时间算术相关的数值要求(Su等人,2024年;Fatemi等人,2025年),而QLlcaptures 与时间语义相关的关系和因果关系推理要求(Wang and Zhao,2024年;Xiong等人,2024年). 通过在项目层面比较这两个维度的需求水平,我们可以测试算术/语义区分是否与认知要求的真正不同,独立于基准设计者指定的标签.

blocks.en: 3.1.2 Operationalising the arithmetic/semantic distinction
blocks.zh: 3.1.2 国家 实行算术/语义区分

blocks.en: We use fine-tuning transfer (see 3.3 ) between temporal arithmetic and semantics as a probe of their separability. If both modes reflect distinct abilities, then training on one should improve performance on tasks from the same mode, and not on tasks from the other. We use two complementary operationalisations to partition the data into these modes.
blocks.zh: 我们利用时间算术和语义之间的微调转移(见3.3)来探测它们的可分离性。 如果两种模式都反映不同的能力,那么,关于一种模式的培训应提高从同一模式而不是从另一个模式开展的任务的绩效。 我们使用两个互补的操作将数据分割到这些模式中.

blocks.en: The first is a dataset-level operationalisation based on existing mode labels. We restrict this controlled transfer analysis to ToTand TRAM, as these are the only benchmarks that provide explicit or reconstructable arithmetic/semantic partitions, minimising confounds from differences in dataset construction, such as annotation assumptions, or task format. ToTprovides an explicit split: its Arithmetic subset covers time/date arithmetic, duration, scheduling, and time zone conversion tasks, while its Semantic subset targets event–event/time, before/after, timeline, and first/last relations. TRAM does not provide such a binary partition. Instead, we follow Su et al. ’s ( 2024 ) classification of TRAM subtasks into math-time tasks (equivalent to arithmetic mode) and pure-time tasks (equivalent to semantic mode) (see Appendix B.2 for details).
blocks.zh: 首先是基于现有模式标签的数据集级操作. 我们把这种有控制的传输分析限制在ToTand TRAM上,因为这些是提供明确或可重建的算术/语义分区的唯一基准,最小化地混淆了数据集构造的差异,如注释假设或任务格式。 ToT提供明确的分割:它的Arithmetic子集涵盖时间/日期算术,持续时间,时间安排,以及时区转换任务,而它的语义子集目标事件-事件/时间,前后,时间表,以及第一/最后的关系. TRAM 不提供这样的二进制分区 。 相反,我们遵循Su等人(2024年)将TRAM子任务分类为数学时任务(相当于算术模式)和纯时任务(相当于语义模式)(详见附录B.2).

blocks.en: The second is an item-level operationalisation based on DeLeAnannotations (Section 3.1.1 ). We partition items by their QLqand QLldemands to construct training sets intended to probe both temporal reasoning modes. Specifically, we filter all datasets to items where demand for QLqexceeds that for QLl, and vice versa, yielding six training conditions. These include two zero-demand controls (Tab. 2 ). It is worth noting that QLqand QLlare rarely the most demanding dimensions in our data. Out of 8,530 training items, QLqis the dominant dimension in only 15 items (1,288 including ties), and QLlin only 1 item (771 including ties). We will discuss the limited role these dimensions seem to play in current benchmarks later.
blocks.zh: 第二个是基于DeLeAnanotes(第3.1.1节)的项目层面操作。 我们用他们的QLqand QLl需求来划分项目,以构建旨在探索两种时间推理模式的训练集. 具体地说,我们将所有数据集过滤到对QLql的需求超过对QLl的需求的项目,反之亦然,从而产生六个训练条件。 其中包括两个零需求控制(第2段)。 值得注意的是,QLqand QLlare很少是我们数据中要求最高的维度. 在8 530个培训项目中,QLqi在15个项目中占据主导地位(1 288个包括领带),QLlin在1个项目中仅占主导地位(771个包括领带)。 我们稍后将讨论这些层面在现有基准中似乎发挥的有限作用。

blocks.en: 3.2 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.2 评价

blocks.en: We use accuracy for evaluation and additionally normalise temporal expressions before scoring, following Abbood et al. (2025) . The expected answer type in the dataset guides the normalisation of the model’s response. E.g., “11 Aug. 2023” and “11/08/2023” are then treated as equivalent. This prevents surface-level differences in temporal formatting from being counted as reasoning failures (details in Appendix C ).
blocks.zh: 在Abbood等人(2025年)之后,我们在评分前使用准确度进行评价,并额外使时间表达正常化。 数据集中的预期答案类型指导了模型响应的正常化. 例如,将“2023年8月11日”和“2023年8月11日”视为等同物。 这使得在时间格式化方面的表层差异无法算作推理失败(详见附录C)。

blocks.en: Aggregate accuracy, however, does not isolate performance on any single cognitive demand dimension, since each item carries a multidimensional DeLeAnlabel. To disentangle the contribution of individual dimensions, we construct subject characteristic curves using dominant slices. For a dominant dimension i i and level l l , we retain only items satisfying x i ( j ) = l x_{i}^{(j)}=l and x i ′ ( j ) ≤ l x_{i^{{}^{\prime}}}^{(j)}\leq l for all i ′ ≠ i i^{{}^{\prime}}\neq i , i.e., items for which dimension i i is the dominant demand. Accuracy is averaged within each level and a two-parameter logistic curve is fitted to the resulting five points, using the weighting scheme of Zhou et al. (2026) . We report the area under the curve (AUC)of the fitted curve as the model’s ability on that dimension.
blocks.zh: 然而,聚合精度并不孤立于任何单个认知需求维度上的性能,因为每个项目都带有多维的DeLeAnnlabel. 为了分辨单个维度的贡献,我们用占优势的切片构建主题特征曲线. 对于占支配地位的维度i和一级l,我们只保留满足xi(j)=lx_{i}^{(j)}=l和xi′i_{i^{{}^{\prime}}}^{(j)}\l}\leq l,所有i′i^{{}^{\i^{{}^{\prime}}\neq i,即其维度的项目. 我才是主要的需求 准确度在每个级别内均值,采用周等人的权重方案(2026年),将二参数的物流曲线与由此形成的五点相配. 我们报告安装曲线曲线下的区域,作为模型在这方面的能力。

blocks.en: Four of the 18 dimensions are excluded from this analysis due to insufficient coverage in our data. Zhou et al. suggests excluding dimensions that have a range narrower than 1–3 or have fewer than 30 items. Spatio-physical Reasoning (SNs)and Verbal Expression (CEe)span only demand levels 1 and 2, too narrow a range for meaningful curve fitting. Conceptualisation, Learning and Abstraction (CL)and Knowledge of Natural Sciences (KNn)yield only 9 and 25 items, respectively, across all dominant slices, making estimates unreliable.
blocks.zh: 由于我们的数据覆盖面不足,18个层面中的4个层面被排除在本分析之外。 周 et等编. 建议排除范围小于1-3或小于30项的维度。 Spatio-physical Reasoning(SN)和Verbal Expression(CEe)只提出1级和2级的需求,范围太窄,无法进行有意义的曲线配置。 概念化,学习和抽象化(CL)和自然科学知识(KNn)分别只生产了9和25项,覆盖了所有的主导片段,使得估计不可靠.

blocks.en: 3.3 Fine-tuning
blocks.zh: 3.3 微调

blocks.en: Our main method for investigating the separability between temporal arithmetic and temporal semantics is to fine-tune models on data for each mode and test the transfer of performance to the corresponding mode.
blocks.zh: 我们调查时间算术和时间语义之间的可分离性的主要方法是微调每种模式的数据模型,并测试性能向相应模式的转移.

blocks.en: Temporal reasoning tasks can require multi-step reasoning. We initially attempted supervised fine-tuning on reasoning traces from a larger teacher model ( Hsieh et al., 2023 ) , without success. We attribute this to a mismatch between the teacher’s and student’s response style ( Li et al., 2025 ) . Instead, we use Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) ( Guo et al., 2025 ) , which sidesteps this issue by optimising directly on self-generated reasoning traces. To ensure comparability across experiments despite substantial variation in dataset sizes, we fix the compute budget to 400 optimisation steps with a batch size of 16. We use 8 generations per rollout for dataset-level operationalisation and 16 for the item-level operationalisation, due to training instabilities with 8 rollouts (details in Appendix D ).
blocks.zh: 时间推理任务可能需要多步骤推理. 我们最初试图从更大的教师模式(Hsieh等人,2023年)中监督地微调推理痕迹,但没有成功。 我们将此归因于教师和学生的反应风格不匹配(Li等人,2025年)。 相反,我们使用集团相对政策优化(GRPO)(Guo等人,2025年),通过直接优化自我产生的推理痕迹来回避这一问题。 为了确保各种实验的可比性,尽管数据集大小有很大差异,但我们将计算预算固定在400个优化步骤中,批量规模为16个。 我们每次推出8代用于数据集层面的操作,16代用于项目层面的操作,原因是培训不稳定,8次推出(详见附录D)。

blocks.en: We define two reward settings to probe the effect of training from complementary directions. In the accuracy setting, the reward is 1 if the model’s response is correct and 0 otherwise, determined by the semantic equivalence metric described in Section 3.2 . In the one-minus-accuracy setting, we invert this signal to explore a form of targeted unlearning similar to Zaradoukas et al. (2026) . The model receives a reward of 1 only if its answer is incorrect but correctly formatted, 0.5 if the answer is both correct and correctly formatted (for richer feedback), and 0 otherwise. The format requirement mitigates reward hacking ( Skalse et al., 2022 ) by preventing models from maximising reward through degenerate outputs. If temporal arithmetic and semantics are separable, unlearning one mode should degrade performance primarily on the same mode, leaving the other largely intact. For experiments using the item-level operationalisation, we additionally scale the reward by 1 + QLq + QLl 1+\text{QLq}+\text{QLl} , so that items with higher quantitative or logical demand contribute a stronger optimisation signal. The goal is to offset the low-resolution binary reward signal, which initially provided limited learning signal across many samples.
blocks.zh: 我们界定了两个奖励设置,以探索从互补方向进行培训的效果。 在精确度设定中,如果模型的反应正确,则奖励为1,否则为0,由第3.2节所述的语义等值度量测定。 在一分准确性设定中,我们反转这个信号,探索一种类似于Zaradoukas等人(2026年)的定向不学习形式. 模型只有在答案不正确但格式正确的情况下才能得到1的奖励,如果答案正确和格式正确(对于更丰富的反馈)则得到0.5的奖励,否则得到0的奖励. 格式要求通过防止模型通过退化的输出来最大化奖励来减轻奖励黑客(Skalse等人,2022年). 如果时间算术和语义是可分离的,不学习一种模式应主要在同一模式下降解性能,使另一种模式基本完好无损. 对于使用项级操作的实验,我们额外将奖励比例缩放为1+QLq+QLl 1+QQText+LqQQQText+Ll},这样,数量或逻辑需求较高的项目就能提供更强大的优化信号. 目标是抵消低分辨率的二进制奖励信号,它最初在许多样本中提供有限的学习信号.

blocks.en: We run our experiments with six models from three families and two size ranges, ensuring that our findings are not an artefact of a single architecture or scale. Specifically, we use Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) , gemma-3-4B-it, and gemma-3-12B-it ( Gemma Team, 2025 ) . Qwen models are run in non-thinking mode for comparability with the other models. During evaluation, we allow up to 4,000 output tokens and set the temperature to 0 for deterministic decoding.
blocks.zh: 我们用来自三个家庭和两个大小范围的六个模型进行实验,确保我们的研究结果不是单一建筑或尺度的人工制品。 具体而言,我们使用Qune3-4B,Qune3-8B(杨等人,2025年),Llama-3.2-3B-指令,Llama-3.1-8B-指令(Grattafiori等人,2024年),Gemma-3-4B-it,以及Gemma-3-12B-it(Gemma Team,2025年). Quen模型以非思考模式运行,以与其他模型的可比性. 在评估期间,我们允许多达4,000个输出符,并将温度设定为0,用于确定解码。

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: 4.1 Cognitive demand profiles do not reflect the temporal reasoning dichotomy
blocks.zh: 4.1 认知需求概况没有反映时间推理二分法

blocks.en: If the arithmetic/semantic distinction reflects a genuine structural property of temporal reasoning, it should be recoverable through the data’s cognitive demands. Specifically, items labelled as temporal arithmetic should exhibit elevated QLqdemands relative to QLl, while items labelled as temporal semantics should show the reverse. We test this prediction in two ways: first by examining the joint distribution of QLqand QLlacross all benchmarks, and then by examining whether the full 18-dimensional demand profiles cluster by mode.
blocks.zh: 如果算术/语义上的区分反映了时间推理的真正结构属性,它应该通过数据的认知要求可以恢复。 具体地说,标注为时间算术的物项应该相对于QLl显示更高的QLq需求,而标注为时间语义的物项应该显示相反的情况. 我们以两种方式测试这种预测:首先通过检查QLqand QLLLlacross所有基准的联合分布,然后通过审查18维需求剖面图是否按模式组合.

blocks.en: Fig. 1 shows that the joint distribution of QLqand QLldemand levels across all benchmark items is mostly similar. Items primarily concentrate near the diagonal, with the modal demand level at 1 for both dimensions. QLltends to exceed QLqslightly more often and reaches higher levels, but the two dimensions are broadly correlated rather than orthogonal.
blocks.zh: 图1显示,QLqand QLl需求水平在所有基准项目中的联合分布基本相似. 物品主要集中在对角线附近,两个维度的模式需求为1级。 QLltends会更频繁地超过QLqs,并达到更高的水平,但这两个维度是广义关联的,而不是正交的.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Joint distribution of QLqand QLldemand levels across all datasets.
blocks.zh: 图1:QLqand QLl需求水平在所有数据集的联合分布.

blocks.en: This pattern persists even in ToT, which is explicitly designed to separate arithmetic from semantic tasks. ToTSemantic has 679 items where QLq ≥ 3 \text{QLq}\geq 3 , while the Arithmetic subset has only 41 items, making the Semantic subset quantitatively more QLqdemanding. This is partly explained by two of the eight Semantic question types ( RelationDuration and NumEventsInTimeInterval ) which require arithmetic operations (see Appendix B.3 for a breakdown of QLqand QLlscores per question type). The full distribution of demand levels for both ToTsubsets is depicted in the Appendix (Fig. 7 ).
blocks.zh: 这种模式甚至在ToT中也依然存在,ToT明确旨在将算术任务与语义任务区分开来. ToTSemantic有679项,其中QLq QQ 3\textQLq}\geq 3,而Arithmetic子集只有41项,使得语义子集在数量上更需要QLq. 部分原因有八种语义问题类型(Relation and NumEvents InTimeInterval)中的两种,需要算术操作(每个问题类型QLqand QLlscore的细分见附录B.3). 附录(图7)说明了ToTsubset两种设备需求水平的全面分布。

blocks.en: Because QLqand QLlalone do not distinguish the two purported modes, we ask whether the distinction emerges when all 18 cognitive dimensions are considered. We therefore apply principal component analysis (PCA)to the DeLeAn-labelled items (Fig. 2 ). The first two principal components’ explained variance is PC1: 40.5% and PC2: 15.5%. If the arithmetic/semantics distinction were a major organising principle, we would expect items from both modes to occupy different regions of this projection. Instead, the dominant structure appears to reflect overall cognitive demand 2 2 2 Overall demand is calculated as the average demand level across all 18 dimensions; see Fig. 6 in Appendix B.4 : Temporal Constraint-based Planning (TCP)and ToTSemantic, the two most demanding datasets in this study, each form a distinct cluster. The remaining benchmarks show no mode-consistent grouping. In short, the leading principal components capture differences in overall benchmark demand but reveal no clustering that supports the arithmetic/semantics distinction.
blocks.zh: 因为QLqand QLLLLONON没有区分两种所谓的模式,所以我们问在考虑所有18个认知维度时,这种区分是否出现. 因此,我们对DeLeAn标注的项目(图2)进行主要组成部分分析。 前两个主要部件解释的差异是PC1:40.5%和PC2:15.5%。 如果算术/语义的区分是一项主要的组织原则,我们期望两种模式的项目占据这一预测的不同区域。 相反,主导结构似乎反映了总体认知需求 2 2 总体需求作为所有18个维度的平均需求水平计算;参见附录B.4中的图6:基于Timperal Control Planning (TCP) and ToTSemantic,本研究中两个最要求的数据集,各自构成一个截然不同的集群. 其余基准显示没有模式一致的分组。 简言之,主要组成部分反映总体基准需求的差异,但没有显示支持算术/语义区分的集群。

blocks.en: Figure 2: PCA of the full 18-dimensional DeLeAnprofiles (PC1: 40.5%, PC2: 15.5%; 56.0% variance explained). TCP and ToT Semantic are annotated; the remaining seven datasets are shown in grey. TCP Long and Short share the TCP label.
blocks.zh: 图2:全18维DeLeAnnopulations的五氯苯甲醚(PC1:40.5%,PC2:15.5%;56.0%的差异得到解释)。 TCP和ToT语义注释;其余七个数据集以灰色显示. TCP长和短共享TCP标签.

blocks.en: 4.2 Performance gains are dataset-specific and do not transfer across modes
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 绩效收益是特定数据集的,不跨模式转移

blocks.en: The cognitive demand analysis above examines what benchmarks require ; we now test what models actually learn . If temporal arithmetic and temporal semantics are separable abilities, then fine-tuning on one mode should improve performance on other datasets from the same mode, and not on datasets from another mode.
blocks.zh: 上面的认知需求分析研究了哪些基准需要;我们现在测试的是哪些模型实际学到了. 如果时间算术和时间语义学是可分离的能力,那么在一种模式上的微调应该能改善其他数据集从同一模式的性能,而不是来自另一种模式的数据集的性能.

blocks.en: To test transfer, we treat the arithmetic and semantic portions of each benchmark as separate subsets, yielding four dataset-mode combinations: ToT-Arithmetic, ToT-Semantic, TRAM-Arithmetic, and TRAM-Semantic. We fine-tune six models separately on each combination and evaluate resulting variants on all four test sets. This design allows us to test transfers across datasets within and across temporal reasoning modes. For each training–test combination, Fig. 3 reports the change in accuracy relative to the corresponding untrained model, averaged across the six models.
blocks.zh: 为了测试传输,我们将每个基准的算术和语义部分作为单独的子集处理,生成四个数据集-模式组合:ToT-Arithmetic,ToT-Semantic,TRAM-Arithmetic,和TRAM-Semantic. 我们分别对每种组合的6个模型进行微调,并在所有4套测试中评价所产生的变体。 这种设计使我们能够在时间推理模式内和时间推理模式之间测试数据集之间的传输。 对于每一次培训-测试组合,图3报告准确性相对于相应的未经培训模型的变化,这在六个模型中是平均的。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Average relative change in accuracy percentage points between the untrained model (baseline) and the trained model. Results averaged over six models from three model families and two sizes. Results shown for the accuracy setting (reward given for correct answers) and one-minus-accuracy setting (reward given for an incorrect but correctly formatted answer).
blocks.zh: 图3:未经培训的模型(基线)与经过培训的模型之间准确度百分点的平均相对变化。 3个模范家庭和2个规模的6个模型的平均结果。 为准确设置(正确答案给予奖励)和一分之一准确设置(错误但格式正确的答案给予奖励)显示的结果。

blocks.en:
In the accuracy reward setting, in-domain gains are substantial and consistent (diagonal in Fig. 3 , left). These gains, however, do not transfer across benchmarks, even when the source and target task share a mode. If the arithmetic/semantic distinction captured coherent, transferable abilities, within-mode transfer should be positive and reliable 3 3 3 This is not inherent to the training method: GRPOyields reliable cross-benchmark
transfer in mathematical reasoning ( Shao et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2026 ) . . Instead, off-diagonal transfer is essentially absent, with one partial exception: training on TRAM arithmetic improves TRAM semantic by 11.1 pp (though the within-dataset gain is far larger, 23.1 pp), and training on TRAM semantic improves TRAM arithmetic by 3.4 pp (with a 15.2 pp gain on TRAM semantic itself). Training on ToTarithmetic, by contrast, degrades TRAM performance ( − 3.2 -3.2 and − 2.9 -2.9 pp). Inspecting model responses shows within-TRAM transfer is largely a formatting effect. The two TRAM modes share the prompt template and a single multiple-choice-letter answer space. Thus, improving answer formatting in one mode recovers otherwise-unparseable responses in the other. The effect does not replicate for ToT, whose two modes differ in both content and answer format (structured JSON vs. event-identifier sets).
blocks.zh:
在精确的奖励设定中,域内收益是实质性和一致的(图3中的对角,左侧)。 然而,即使来源和目标任务共享一种模式,这些收益也不会跨基准转移。 如果算术/语义上的区别是连贯的、可转移的能力,模式内转让应是正的和可靠的 3 3 GPO产值可靠的跨基准
(Shao等人,2024年;Guo等人,2025年;Hu等人,2026年). 相反,离对角转移基本上不存在,只有一个部分例外:关于TRAM算术的培训使TRAM语义学改进了11.1pp(虽然数据集内增益要大得多,23.1pp),关于TRAM语义学的培训使TRAM语义学改进了3.4pp(关于TRAM语义学本身的15.2pp增益). 相比之下,关于Totarithmetic的培训降低了TRAM的性能(-3.2-3.2和-2.9-2.9页)。 检查模型反应显示TRAM内部的传输基本上是一种格式化效果. 两个TRAM模式共享快速模板和一个单一的多选择字母解答空间. 因此,改进一种模式的答案格式可以恢复另一种模式的无法解答。 该效应不为ToT复制,ToT在内容和答题格式上两种模式不同(结构化的JSON vs. 事件识别器集).

blocks.en: The one-minus-accuracy experiments (Fig. 3 , right) provide a complementary perspective. Performance degradation mirrors the localised, dataset-specific nature of accuracy gains. This effect is most pronounced for ToTarithmetic ( − 26 -26 pp) and ToT Semantic ( − 22.8 -22.8 pp). However, degradation spreads more broadly off-diagonal than improvement does.
blocks.zh: 一分精度实验(图3,右)提供了补充视角. 性能退化反映了准确性提高的本地化、数据集的具体性质。 这种效果对ToTarithmetic(-26-26pp)和ToT语义(-22.8-22.8pp)最为明显. 然而,降解比改善更为广泛。

blocks.en: Notably, gains and losses are not symmetric across reward settings. For TRAM, accuracy training transfers arithmetic improvements to semantics more strongly than the reverse, whereas unlearning reverses this asymmetry. This suggests that the two TRAM subsets share surface-level regularities that are learned and unlearned asymmetrically, rather than drawing on a common underlying ability.
blocks.zh: 值得注意的是,在奖励背景下,损益并不对称。 对于TRAM来说,精度训练将算术上的改进转移到语义学上比相反的更强烈,而不学习则会扭转这种不对称. 这表明,两个TRAM子集共享表层常态,这些常态是非对称的,而不是利用共同的基础能力。

blocks.en:
Overall, these results suggest that abilities learned during fine-tuning are highly localised to individual datasets rather than transferable improvements in temporal arithmetic or semantic reasoning. Per-model results (Appendix F ,
Tab. 22 ) confirm that this pattern is consistent across all six models and not driven by individual outliers.
blocks.zh:
总的来说,这些结果表明,在微调过程中学到的能力被高度本地化为单个数据集,而不是时间算术或语义推理的可转移改进. 每个模型的结果(附录F,
图22)证实,这一模式在所有6种模型中都是一致的,而不是由个别外力驱动的.

blocks.en: An exploratory experiment with Qwen3-32B produces smaller and mixed transfer effects, including a 3.7-point gain from TRAM Arithmetic to ToTArithmetic, but does not establish a consistent mode-specific pattern (Appendix H ).
blocks.zh: 一次与Qune3-32B的探索性实验产生了较小的和混合的转移效应,包括从TRAM算术到TOTA算术的3.7分增益,但没有建立一致的模式特定模式(Appendix H ).

blocks.en: 4.3 Quantitative and logical reasoning are not the main drivers for performance
blocks.zh: 4.3 数量和逻辑推理不是业绩的主要驱动因素

blocks.en: The preceding transfer experiments use benchmark-defined labels to distinguish the two temporal-reasoning modes. We complement them with an item-level operationalisation by training on data filtered by relative QLqand QLldemands (Sec. 3.1.2 ) and measuring changes in DeLeAn-defined capabilities. This asks a finer-grained question: when trained on data with high quantitative or logical demands, do models improve most on those dimensions, as the arithmetic/semantic distinction predicts, or on other capabilities?
blocks.zh: 之前的转移实验使用基准定义的标签来区分两种时间推理模式. 我们通过对由相对的QLqand QLl需求(Sec. 3.1.2)过滤的数据进行培训和测量DeLeAn定义能力的变化,对数据进行项目层面的操作,以补充它们。 这提出了一个更细微的问题:当在数量或逻辑需求高的数据方面接受培训时,模型在这些维度上是否有最大的改进,如算术/语义区分预测,还是其他能力?

blocks.en: Accuracy for evaluation is insufficient here, because we are interested in changes across the full capability profile rather than end-task performance alone. We therefore compute DeLeAn-based subject characteristic curves as described in Section 3.2 and use the AUCacross 14 retained dimensions as a summary measure of model ability on each dimension. Fig. 4 reports the average change in AUCrelative to baseline, averaged across all six models for both experimental settings. Per-model results are in the Appendix F .
blocks.zh: 这里评价的准确性不足,因为我们对整个能力概况的变化感兴趣,而不只是对结束任务的业绩感兴趣。 因此,我们计算第3.2节所述的基于DeLeAn的主题特征曲线,并使用AUCAcross 14保留维度作为每个维度的模型能力的总结度量。 图4报告了与基准相对应的平均变化,这两个实验环境的所有六个模型的平均变化。 每个模型的结果载于附录F。

blocks.en: The arithmetic and semantic modes contrast temporal reasoning that requires explicit calculation with temporal reasoning that does not. If true, we would expect QLq-dominant training to primarily improve QLq(and hence temporal arithmetic), and the equivalent for QLl-dominant training. This is not what we observe. Training on data where QLl = QLq + 1 \text{QLl}=\text{QLq}+1 yields the largest improvements for both QLqand QLl, rather than selectively boosting QLl. The QLl = QLq + 2 \text{QLl}=\text{QLq}+2 condition produces weaker gains, possibly due to its small dataset size (54 items). QLq-dominant training, where QLq = QLl + { 1 , 2 } \text{QLq}=\text{QLl}+\{1,2\} , also does not preferentially improve QLq. Because QLqdemands are generally lower than QLldemands across the benchmarks (Fig. 6 in the Appendix), QLq-dominant items may not provide a sufficiently challenging learning signal for that dimension.
blocks.zh: 算术模式和语义模式对比了需要明确计算的时间推理和没有时间推理. 如果真是这样,我们期望QLq主力训练能主要改善QLq(从而改进时间算术),并达到QLl主力训练的等效. 这不是我们所观察到的。 QLl = QLq + 1\text → Ll}=\text → Lqq → 1的数据培训对QLl和QLl两者都产生最大的改进,而不是有选择地提升QLl. QLl = QLq + 2\ text + Ll}=\text → Lq}+2条件产生较弱的增益,可能是由于其数据集小(54项). QLq-支配训练,其中QLq=QLl + {1,2}\text=Lq}=\text+Ll}+\{1,2\},也没有优先改进QLq. 由于跨基准的QLq需求一般低于QLl需求(附录中图6),QLq主导项目可能无法为这个维度提供足够具有挑战性的学习信号.

blocks.en: To test whether low QL demand in the temporal training data (mean demand of 1.57) explains the limited performance gains, we fine-tune models on QL-dominant, non-temporal data (mean demand of 4.13). Although QLland QLqboth increase by 0.15 AUC—the largest capability gains among all dimensions—accuracy on the temporal mix data remains unchanged (mean Δ = − 0.06 \Delta=-0.06 pp; range − 1.23 -1.23 to + 0.55 +0.55 ; Appendix G , Tables 23 , 24 ). Thus, stronger QL capability is insufficient to improve temporal reasoning and QL is not the principal bottleneck in model performance.
blocks.zh: 为了检验时间培训数据中低QL需求(平均需求1.57)是否解释了有限的性能收益,我们微调了QL主控非时空数据的模型(平均需求4.13). 虽然QLland QLqboth增加0.15 AUC——在所有维度中最大的能力增益——但时间混合数据的准确性保持不变(平均= = − 0.06\Delta=-0.06页;范围= 1.23-1.23至+0.55+0.55;附录G,表23、24)。 因此,更强的QL能力不足以改善时间推理,QL并不是模型性能的主要瓶颈.

blocks.en: The most revealing finding (Fig. 4 , top) emerges when we examine which dimensions benefit most across all six training conditions. Gains in Knowledge of Social Sciences (KNs), Customary Everyday Knowledge (KNc), and Verbal Comprehension (CEc)consistently exceed gains in QLland QLq(often by a wide margin). This pattern holds regardless of whether the training data was selected for its quantitative or logical demands. In other words, even when we deliberately select items that emphasise arithmetic or logical reasoning, models primarily improve on KNc, KNsand CEc. The one-minus-accuracy results (Fig. 4 , bottom) corroborate this from the reverse direction: the largest capability degradations occur for the KNsdimension, confirming that these are the abilities most exercised by current temporal benchmarks. The per-benchmark demand distributions (Appendix B.4 , Fig. 7 ) provide further support. Most benchmarks concentrate their QLqand QLldemands at levels 0–2, with few items at the higher levels, which would be necessary to expect reasoning bottlenecks.
blocks.zh: 当我们审查所有6个培训条件中哪些方面受益最大时,最有启发性的发现(图4,最高)。 社会科学知识(KNs)、日常知识(KNc)和Verbal Confederationon(CEc)方面的收益持续超过QLland QLq(往往以较大幅度)方面的收益。 无论培训数据是根据其数量还是逻辑要求选定的,这种模式都保持不变。 换句话说,即使我们故意选择强调算术或逻辑推理的项目,模型也主要改进了KNc,KNsand CEc. 一分之一的准确性结果(图4,底部)从相反的方向证实了这一点:最大的能力退化发生在KNsdimension,证实这些是目前时间基准最能发挥的能力。 每个基准的需求分布(附录B.4,图7)提供进一步支持. 大多数基准将其QLqand QLl需求集中在0–2级,高层次的项目很少,这对于预期推理瓶颈是必要的.

blocks.en: Relabelling with Gemini largely reproduces the KN-over-QL pattern seen in Fig. 4 , although KNsrather than KNcbenefits most and CEcgains are smaller (details in Appendix E ).
blocks.zh: 与双子座重贴标签在很大程度上复制了图4中看到的KN-over-QL模式,虽然KNsrather比KNcfeels大部分和CEgains更小(详见附录E).

blocks.en: These results suggest that logical and quantitative reasoning are not the primary drivers of performance on current temporal reasoning benchmarks. Training on examples selected for their logical or quantitative demands does affect those dimensions, but the dominant effect falls on knowledge dimensions. This finding reinforces the conclusion from Sections 4.1 and 4.2 : existing temporal reasoning benchmarks do not cleanly instantiate the arithmetic/semantics distinction. Instead, they largely measure models’ capacity to retrieve and apply learned temporal regularities.
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,逻辑和定量推理并不是目前时间推理基准方面业绩的主要驱动因素。 就其逻辑或数量要求所选实例进行培训确实影响到这些层面,但主要影响在于知识层面。 这一结论强化了第4.1节和第4.2节的结论:现有的时间推理基准不能完全即时地区分算术/语义。 相反,它们主要衡量模型检索和应用所学时间规律的能力。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: This study scrutinises whether temporal arithmetic and temporal semantics correspond to distinct reasoning abilities. Capability-aware analyses of the dataset and fine-tuning experiments show that they do not. Cognitive demand profiles fail to separate arithmetic from semantic benchmark items, despite supposed differences in required quantitative and logical reasoning. Furthermore, finetuning gains do not transfer between benchmarks of the same temporal reasoning mode.
blocks.zh: 本研究仔细研究了时间算术和时间语义是否与不同的推理能力相对应. 对数据集的能力认识分析以及微调实验表明它们没有. 认知需求简介未能将算术项目与语义基准项目分开,尽管在所需数量和逻辑推理方面假定存在差异。 此外,调整收益不会在相同时间推理模式的基准之间转移。

blocks.en: Capability changes after finetuning on temporal data show that DeLeAnknowledge dimensions improve more than QLqor QLl. Specialised QL-heavy training could raise QL capability, but still did not improve performance in either temporal reasoning modes. Our results suggest that current benchmarks test the retrieval and application of time-related regularities, not arithmetic or semantic abilities. The arithmetic/semantics taxonomy may describe task form, but it should not be treated as a salient decomposition of temporal reasoning. Future benchmarks should control for knowledge demands and validate proposed categories through capability-based analyses.
blocks.zh: 在对时间数据进行微调后的能力变化表明,DeLeAnnows维度比QLqor QLl的改进更多. 专门的QL-重力训练可以提高QL能力,但在两个时间推理模式中都仍然没有提高性能. 我们的结果表明,目前的基准检验了时间规律的检索和应用,而不是算术或语义能力。 算术/语义分类学可以描述任务形式,但不应该把它视为时间推理的显著分解. 未来基准应控制知识需求,并通过基于能力的分析验证拟议类别。

blocks.en: 6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 限制

blocks.en: Our experiments use models of up to 12 billion parameters. In one instance, we trained a larger model, which showed small transfer (improvement of ≈ 3 \approx 3 percentage points) in the arithmetic mode. Future work could explore transfer dynamics in even larger models; however, the consistency of our findings across three families and two scales suggests that this pattern is robust. Furthermore, our transfer experiments are limited to ToTand TRAM, which are the only benchmarks with explicit or reconstructable arithmetic and semantic partitions. Extending this analysis to future benchmarks that provide more detailed task taxonomies would strengthen the generalisability of our findings.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验使用了多达120亿参数的模型. 在一个例子中,我们训练了一个更大的模型,显示在算术模式中小幅转移(改进了 QQ 3\约3个百分点). 今后的工作可以在更大的模式中探索转让动态;然而,我们三个家庭和两个尺度的调查结果的一致性表明,这种模式是强有力的。 此外,我们的转移实验仅限于ToTand TRAM,这是有明确或可重建的算术和语义分区的唯一基准. 将这一分析扩大到今后提供更详细任务分类的基准,将加强我们调查结果的普遍性。

In this paper, we use these demand vectors as structured, interpretable item-level features for analysing which cognitive capabilities current temporal reasoning benchmarks actually require.

blocks.en: B.2 Partitioning TRAM into arithmetic and semantic tasks
blocks.zh: B.2 将TRAM分割为算术和语义任务

blocks.en: Unlike ToT, which provides an explicit arithmetic/semantic split, TRAM organises its tasks into categories such as foundational temporal understanding, temporal interpretation and computation, and advanced temporal concepts, rather than assigning a binary mode label. To derive an arithmetic/semantic partition for TRAM, we follow Su et al. (2024) ’s distinction between math-time tasks and pure-time tasks . TRAM’s subtasks Frequency , Duration , Arithmetic , and Ambiguity are classified as math-time tasks, corresponding to the arithmetic mode. We therefore assign these four subtasks to the arithmetic split.
blocks.zh: 与ToT提供了明确的算术/语义分裂不同,TRAM将其任务组织为基础时间理解,时间解释和计算,以及高级时间概念等类别,而不是指定二进制模式标签. 为了获得TRAM的算术/语义分区,我们遵循Su等人(2024年)对数学时间任务和纯时间任务的区分。 TRAM的子任务频率,持续时间,算术,和安比吉特被归类为数学时间任务,对应算术模式. 因此,我们指定这四个子任务为算术分裂.

blocks.en: Appendix C Metrics
blocks.zh: 附录C

blocks.en: To reduce spurious mismatches caused by formatting variability, we evaluate model outputs with benchmark-specific post-processing before computing final scores. Across our evaluation modules, normalisation generally takes one of three forms: extracting the answer from a larger generated response, canonicalising the representation of the answer, and then comparing either normalised strings, normalised structured objects, or normalised sets. The exact procedure differs by benchmark.
blocks.zh: 为了减少格式化可变性造成的虚假错配,我们在计算最终分数之前,先用特定基准的后处理来评价模型输出. 在我们的评价模块中,正常化一般采取三种形式之一:从更大的生成的响应中提取答案,对答案的表示进行空洞化,然后比较正常化的字符串,正常化的结构化对象,或正常化的组合。 具体程序因基准而异。

blocks.en: C.1 TRAM accuracy
blocks.zh: C.1 TRAM的准确性

blocks.en: For TRAM, we normalise predictions by extracting the final option letter from responses matching the template “The final answer is (X)”, with X ∈ { A , B , C , D } \text{X}\in\{A,B,C,D\} . We then compute exact-match accuracy against the gold option label. This removes variability in preceding reasoning text but still requires a standardised final-answer template.
blocks.zh: 对于TRAM,我们通过从“最后答案是(X)”模板的响应中提取最后选项字母,与X {{A,B,C,D}\text {in}A,B,C,D}对应,实现预测正常化。 然后根据黄金选项标签 计算准确的匹配率 这消除了先前推理文本中的变异性,但仍需要一个标准化的最终答案模板.

blocks.en: C.2 TCP accuracy
blocks.zh: C.2 TCP精度

blocks.en: For TCP, the evaluator expects the model’s final answer to appear in boxed LaTeX notation, using the pattern \boxed{...} . It extracts the boxed span with the regular expression \\boxed\{([^}]*)\} and strips surrounding white space from the extracted content. Comparison is then performed by exact string match.
blocks.zh: 对于TCP,评估者期望模型的最终答案出现在框式的LaTeX注解中,使用模式\boxed{}. 它以正则表达式\\ boxed {([^}*]}}}} 提取框间距,并从提取的内容中剥离围绕白色空间的条纹。 然后通过精确的字符串匹配来进行比较。

blocks.en: In the TCP Short subset only, the evaluator removes the literal string “GMT” from both the prediction and the reference before comparison; no analogous normalisation is applied for TCP Long. The system prompt includes the exact expected answer format.
blocks.zh: 仅在TCP Short子集中,评价者会在比较前从预测和参考中去掉字串“GMT”;TCP Long没有类似的正常化。 系统提示包括准确的预期答案格式。

blocks.en: C.3 Test of Time
blocks.zh: C.3 联合国 时间测试

blocks.en: For ToT, we extract the first valid JSON object from the model output, after escaping unescaped control characters inside JSON strings. We discard the explanation field and compare only the answer-bearing content. In the Arithmetic subset, we additionally normalise schema mismatches such as age versus answer, lowercase items in ordered_list and unordered_list answer types, cast prediction values to the reference types when possible, and sort unordered_list values to make comparison order-invariant. In the Semantic subset, we normalise both prediction and reference by converting them to strings before exact comparison.
blocks.zh: 对于ToT,我们从模型输出中提取第一个有效的JSON对象,在JSON字符串内逃脱未逃脱的控制字符之后. 我们放弃解释字段,只比较包含答案的内容。 在Aristemetic子集中,我们额外地将年龄与答案等计划错配,命令的_list和未命令的_list answertype中的小写项目,尽可能将预测值投放到参考类型,并排序未命令的_list值,使比较顺序不变量. 在语义子集中,我们通过在精确比较之前将它们转换成字符串,从而实现预测和引用的正常化.

blocks.en: C.4 TimeBench derived benchmarks
blocks.zh: C.4 时间奔驰衍生基准

blocks.en: For TimeBench tasks, we first extract the final answer from the text following the marker “Thus, the correct answer is:”. We retain only the first subsequent line, strip trailing sentence punctuation, and canonicalise any response containing unanswerable to the label unanswerable. For TempReason, TimeQA, and MenatQA, the extracted answer is scored with standard SQuAD exact match and F1. For Date Arithmetic, predictions and references are parsed into date objects and normalised by setting the day to 1, so comparison is effectively at the month-year level. For TimeDial, prediction and reference are mapped to sets of selected options in A,B,C,D and scored using set exact match and set-based F1.
blocks.zh: 对于Time Bench任务,我们首先从“因此,正确的答案是:”标记之后的案文中提取最后的答案。 我们只保留了第一行, 剥去后面的句子 标注, 对于TempReason,TimeQA,和MenatQA,提取的答案以标准SQuAD精确匹配和F1. 对于日期算术(Date Arithmetic),预测和引用被解析成日期对象,并通过将日设为1实现常态化,因此比较在月份级别上是有效的. 对于TimeDial,预测和参考被映射到A,B,C,D中的一系列选定选项,并使用设定精确匹配和设定基数F1来打分.

blocks.en: C.5 Non-temporal multiple-choice accuracy
blocks.zh: C.5 非时态多选择精度

blocks.en: For single-answer multiple-choice examples from the Civil Service Examination, LSAT, MMLU-Pro, and the relevant Math tasks, we inspect the final 300 characters of the completion. We preferentially extract the final option letter in { A , … , J } \{\mathrm{A},\ldots,\mathrm{J}\} appearing in an answer-bearing expression such as “the answer is X”, “answer: X”, “option X”, or “choice X”, or as a standalone line. If no such expression is found, we fall back to the final isolated letter in this range. The extracted letter is uppercased and compared by exact match with the gold option label.
blocks.zh: 对于公务员考试,LSAT,MMLU-Pro的单答多选例以及相关的数学任务,我们检查完成的最后300个字符. 我们优先在 {A, ..., J } { mathrm{A},\ ldots,\ mathrm{J } 中提取最后的选项字母, 以“ 答案是 X, “ 答案是 X”, “ 选项 X”, 或“ 选择 X” 等包含答案的表达方式出现, 或作为单独的行出现 。 如果找不到这样的表达式,我们回到这个范围内的最后一个孤立字母. 提取的字母为大写,与黄金选项标签精确匹配比较.

blocks.en: C.6 TruthQuest accuracy
blocks.zh: C.6 事实 查询准确性

blocks.en: For TruthQuest, the reference annotation is converted to the set of option labels corresponding to knights. From the final 300 characters of the completion, we collect option letters in answer-bearing expressions; if none are present, we collect all isolated letters in { A , … , J } \{\mathrm{A},\ldots,\mathrm{J}\} . Both prediction and reference are treated as sets, so ordering and duplicate labels are ignored. A reward of 1 is assigned only when the predicted and reference sets are identical.
blocks.zh: 对于 TruthQuest,参考注释转换为对应骑士的一组选项标签. 从完成的最后300个字符中,我们收集包含答题的表达式中的选项字母;如果不存在,我们收集{A,...,J} {mathrm{A},\ldots,\mathrm{J}中的所有孤立字母. 预测和引用都作为套件处理,因此顺序和重复标签被忽略. 只有在预测和参考组完全相同时,才给予1的奖励。

blocks.en: C.7 Math and OmniMath accuracy
blocks.zh: C.7 数学和精度

blocks.en: Math examples use several answer representations. Multiple-choice items follow the option-letter procedure above. For integer-valued Math and OmniMath items, we extract the final integer appearing in the last 200 characters of the completion, cast it to an integer, and compare it exactly with the reference. For sequence-valued Math items, we extract the last valid JSON array from the complete response and compare it directly with the reference list; this comparison is order-sensitive.
blocks.zh: 数学实例使用多个答案表示. 多项选择项目遵循上述选项字母程序。 对于整数值的数学和OmniMath项目,我们提取完成后最后200个字符中出现的最终整数,将其铸成整数,并精确地与引用比较. 对于序列值的数学项目,我们从完整的响应中提取最后一个有效的JSON阵列,并将其与参考列表直接比较;这种比较对顺序敏感.

blocks.en: For fraction-valued OmniMath items, we parse a LaTeX fraction written using \frac , \dfrac , or \tfrac . If no valid LaTeX fraction is found, we use the final plain-text fraction of the form p / q p/q . The numerator and denominator are converted to an exact rational number and reduced to the canonical string p / q p/q before exact comparison with the similarly normalised reference.
blocks.zh: 对于分数值的 OmniMath 项, 我们分析使用\ frac 、\ dfrac 或\ tfrac 编写的 LaTeX 分数 。 如果找不到有效的 LaTeX 分数, 我们使用表单 p / q p/ q 中的最后纯文本分数 。 计数器和分母在与类似常态化的参考物进行精确比较之前,被转换成一个精确的合理数字,并缩放到犬形字符串p / q p/q.

blocks.en: C.8 ChemLLMBench and Reasoning accuracy
blocks.zh: C.8 化学品和合理准确性

blocks.en: For the SMILES-valued ChemLLMBench examples, we scan the completion from right to left for a whitespace-delimited SMILES-like token that can be parsed by RDKit. The predicted molecule is converted to canonical isomeric SMILES and compared by exact string match with the canonicalised reference.
blocks.zh: 对于SMILES值为ChemLLMBench的示例,我们从右到左扫描完成,以获取一个可以由RDKit解析的白空限定的SMILES类符号. 预测的分子被转换成 canonical异构SMILES,并通过精确的字符串匹配与cononical化的参考物进行比较.

blocks.en: For free-text Reasoning examples, we inspect the final 300 characters of the completion, lowercase the text, remove punctuation, and collapse consecutive whitespace. We apply the same normalisation to the reference and award a match when the normalised reference occurs as a substring of the normalised completion.
blocks.zh: 对于自由文本原因例,我们检查完成的最终300个字符,小写文本,去掉标点,并连续折叠白空间. 在正常的引用作为正常的完成的子串发生时,我们对引用适用同样的规范,并授予匹配。

Tab. 22 disaggregates these results, reporting the baseline accuracy range (min, median, max across models), the mean and median performance delta, and the number of models that improved versus worsened for each train–test combination under both reward settings.

blocks.en: Several patterns are worth noting. First, in-domain gains under the accuracy reward are consistent across all six models: every model improves on its own training set (6/0 in all diagonal cells). Second, the absence of cross-benchmark transfer is not driven by individual outliers. For most off-diagonal cells, the number of models that improve versus worsen is close to 3/3, indicating that the lack of transfer is a stable property of the task structure rather than an artefact of averaging. Third, under the one-minus-accuracy reward, unlearning is similarly concentrated: for example, training on ToTArithmetic degrades all six models on ToTArithmetic (0/6) and five of six on TRAM Arithmetic (1/5), confirming that the unlearning signal is reliably absorbed. Finally, the wide baseline range (e.g., 25.74–87.74 for TRAM Arithmetic) reflects genuine variation in model strength, yet the direction of transfer effects is consistent across this range, further supporting the robustness of our conclusions.
blocks.zh: 有几个模式值得注意。 首先,准确性奖励下的域内收益在所有六个模型中都是一致的:每个模型在自己的训练集(所有对角细胞的6/0)上都有改进. 其次,没有跨基准转移并非由个人外力驱动. 对于大多数非对角细胞来说,改进与恶化的模型数量接近3/3,表明缺乏转移是任务结构的稳定属性,而不是平均值的动脉。 第三,在一分精度奖励下,不学习同样集中:例如,关于TOTA算术的培训将TOTA算术的所有六个模型(0/6)和关于TRAM算术的六个模型中的五个(1/5)降解,证实不学习信号是可靠吸收的. 最后,广泛的基线范围(如TRAM Arithmetic的25.74–87.74)反映了模型强度的真正变化,然而转移效应的方向在此范围内是一致的,进一步支持了我们结论的稳健性.

blocks.en: We also explored scaling the experiments to larger models, but the computational cost of GRPO prevented us from running the full experimental suite. For example, the length of some ToTprompts, which can span several thousand tokens, would have been much higher than for TRAM. Nevertheless, we trained Qwen3-32B separately on the TRAM Arithmetic and Semantic subsets using the standard accuracy-reward configuration and evaluated both variants on all TRAM and ToTsubsets. Figure 9 reports the resulting changes in accuracy.
blocks.zh: 我们还探索了将实验推广到更大的模型,但是GRPO的计算成本使我们无法运行完整的实验套房. 例如,一些ToTprompts的长度可以跨越几千个令牌,比TRAM的长度要高得多. 尽管如此,我们还是利用标准的精度奖励配置,在TRAM算术和语义子集上分别培训了Qune3-32B,并对所有TRAM和ToT子集上的两个变体进行了评价. 图9报告了由此产生的准确性变化。

blocks.en: Training on TRAM Arithmetic improves ToTArithmetic by 3.7 percentage points, nearly matching the 3.9-point in-domain gain, while ToTSemantic improves by 1.9 points. Training on TRAM Semantic improves ToTSemantic by 1.9 points, but also increases TRAM Arithmetic by 2.7 points. Overall, however, the changes range from − 0.2 -0.2 to + 3.9 +3.9 points, substantially smaller than the in-domain gains of + 6.8 +6.8 to + 23.1 +23.1 points observed across the models in Figure 3 . These results therefore provide tentative evidence of arithmetic transfer, but not a consistent mode-specific transfer pattern. Because they come from a single larger model, it remains unclear whether the observed pattern reflects model scale or ordinary performance variation.
blocks.zh: 关于TRAM算术的培训提高了TOTA算术3.7个百分点,几乎与3.9分的域内收益相匹配,而TOTSemantic则提高了1.9分. 关于TRAM语义学的培训提高了Totsemantic的1.9分,但也增加了TRAM语义学2.7分. 然而,总的来说,变化幅度从− 0.2-0.2到+3.9+3.9点不等,大大小于图3各模型中观测到的+6.8+6.8到+23.1+23.1点。 因此,这些结果提供了算术转移的暂定证据,但并不是一个一致的模式特定转移模式。 由于它们来自一个更大的单一模型,仍然不清楚所观测到的模式是反映了模型尺度还是普通的性能变化.
